zh: 升级首页新手引导：支持逐步输入并发送「报表与一键催办」AI 提问示例，并联动数据抓取、数据导入等系统工具页引导。
AI 问答新增最新入库快照的一键催办事项检索与更多责任人字段识别，取消在普通库查询中常驻无关技能工具；同时支持自定义工具中英文名称同步更新及优化双语运行、桌面配额栏与运维收件箱体验。
en: Upgraded the homepage product tour with an interactive AI example prompt for report metrics and one-click follow-ups, plus synced system tool tour steps.

Added latest report snapshot follow-up grounding and richer owner field matching for AI Q&A, stopped preloading unrelated skill tools on database turns, and improved bilingual custom tool naming/runtime, desktop quota bar, and ops inbox handling.
